recipe.title: Speedy corn or pea bread
recipe.notes: This is from Nadia Lim's recipe book, 'Yum!'
recipe.prep: Preheat oven to 180 deg C. Line a loaf tin or small baking dish with baking paper.

i.n: corn kernels or peas (frozen and defrosted is fine)

method.s: Using a food processor or stick blender, blend eggs and corn/peas until almost smooth.
Transfer to a bowl and stir through flour, baking powder and cheese.
Pour into lined loaf tin or baking dish.
Bake for 15-20 minutes until set and light golden.
Remove from tin and allow to cool slightly on a wire rack. Cut into about 6 fingers.
